file_id: Paritala Satya Narayana, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 24 October, 2019

sentences.text:
Paritala Satya Narayana, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 24
October, 2019

Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.6387 Of 2019
Order:

1. This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/accused under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in C.C No.25 of 2019 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate, Giddalur, Prakasam District for the offences punishable under Sections 188 and 273 of Indian Penal Code (for short "I.P.C.") and Sections 58, 59 and 63 3.1 (ZZ) (V) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate, Giddalur, Prakasam District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State, submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.
3.
In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State, this criminal petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY 24.10.2019 Rvk Paritala Satya Narayana, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 24 October, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178166717/
